items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: But Johnny Dodds was my hero for a long time.

ctx.x: Skinny, pale, with sort of bad hair, wavy, curly hair you know. And he looked like a nerd. But he played wonderfully. I said Jesus Christ he scared me to death. And I was sort of like, in retrospect I was sort of a nature boy, you know, with the red notes and a lot of wails and wooo. Soulful. You’re trying to imitate Johnny Dodds. I mean I didn’t — I liked Benny Goodman but I didn’t aspire to that kind of clarinet that I wanted to play. But Johnny Dodds was my hero for a long time.
